name: Hyrcania
description: Open steppe country in the far northeast of Mainland Asia, rising into mountains. Where Guyuk tore the crimson portal to Naraka Lok.
notes: Canon attests this ground twice under two spellings: `event_naraka_portal` puts Guyuk and Nirigili on the Hyrkanian steppe, and the reference map labels the same northeast country `HYRCANIA ?`. The two were first entered separately, because neither source says they are the same and a resemblance is not an identity. Confirmed as one place by the author, 2026-08-27, and merged; the steppe name is kept as an alias because that is the spelling the event uses. Ground rather than building: it is here before anyone names it and after they stop. Ground rather than building: it is here before anyone names it and after they stop.
